newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks seen powering on, testing record high.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks seen powering on, testing record high.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to gather momentum on Friday with brokers seeing the Hang Seng Index testing its all-time high of 14,004.93 points, driven by gains in Wall Street stocks overnight.
"It may test the record high today. People are very confident since the market rose yesterday despite a fall in U.S. stocks (on Wednesday)," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
He said a recovery of U.S. stocks on Thursday, with the Dow industrials rising 50.97 points to 7,136.62, should bolster sentiment.
"Money from overseas, China and everywhere continues to flow in," said Mak.

But Michael Ng, dealing director at Sassoon Securities, said stocks could meet some selling later. "Profit-taking may set in this afternoon after the Hang Seng touches 14,000 since people are not willing to hold big positions ahead of the weekend."

The Hang Seng Index surged 134.39 points to 13,740.30 on Thursday, its highest close since its record close of 13,868.24 on January 20. Later the Hang Seng London Reference Index jumped a further 189.78 points to 13,930.08.
